# Data Card — AnomalyThink Reasoning-Trace Corpus

> Companion data documentation for the TU Delft MSc thesis (2026, Adnane Acudad):
> *Reasoning-Enhanced Vision-Language Models for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Detection* (Qwen2.5-VL).
> This card describes the reasoning-trace text datasets shipped under [`../traces/`](../traces/).
> See [`../README.md`](../README.md) for the full repository overview and the secret-rotation notice.

---

## 1. Summary

The reasoning supervision used in this thesis is a corpus of **~14,472 single-pass
"C1-only" reasoning traces** generated by **Gemini-2.5-Flash** over Real-IAD product
images. The corpus is named **AnomalyThink-15K** (~14,472 ≈ 15K). Each trace is a short
chain-of-thought industrial-inspection report wrapped in `<think>...</think>` followed by
a structured verdict (`<answer>`, plus `<location>` and `<type>` for anomalies).

AnomalyThink-15K is partitioned into **three disjoint, stratified (product × normal/anomaly)
splits**:

| Split | Count | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **SFT** | **6,000** (3,000 anomaly + 3,000 normal) | Supervised fine-tuning — the headline SFT model (7B-frozen-6K, ckpt-564) |
| **GRPO** | **4,236** (2,118 anomaly + 2,118 normal) | RL training prompts (GRPO Run-2, base = ckpt-564) |
| **Held-out Real-IAD** | **4,236** | Generalization test set — never seen in SFT or GRPO |

> The SFT split (6,000) is a **strict subset** of the 14,472. The full AnomalyThink-15K
> union is the concatenation of a **10,236-record SFT pool** (which contains the 6K) and the
> **4,236-record GRPO split**; these two are disjoint and sum to exactly 14,472. The held-out
> Real-IAD evaluation set is the **same 4,236 images as the GRPO split**, held out from
> SFT — it is used for the *n* = 4236 held-out Real-IAD benchmark, not shipped as a separate
> file (the GRPO file `grpo_train.json` is its on-disk source of images and questions).

### Why "6K beats 15K" is a composition effect, not a length/quality effect

The 6K SFT split and the full 15K union have the **same mean `<think>` length (~137 words;
the thesis rounds this to ~141)**, verified directly on the shipped JSONs. The empirical
result that *SFT on 6K outperforms SFT on 15K at fixed compute* is therefore a
**data-count / composition** effect, **not** a verbosity, trace-length, or
quality-filtering effect. No quality filter was applied to shrink 15K → 6K; the 6K is a
clean stratified subsample.

## 2. Source data and provenance

- **Source images:** [Real-IAD](https://realiad4ad.github.io/Real-IAD/) industrial
  anomaly-detection dataset. The AnomalyThink-15K corpus uses Real-IAD parts; the
  per-record image roots are `/data/Real-IAD/...` (and `/data/realiad-variety/...` for the
  in-progress Variety STaR corpus — see §7).
- **Product split (Appendix A of the thesis):** the documented design splits Real-IAD
  products **25 train / 5 held-out**. The *actual* distinct-product counts in the shipped
  files differ slightly (see §4 — the SFT pool spans 30 products, the GRPO/held-out split
  spans 23). The Appendix-A table records the intended split; the on-disk counts are
  authoritative for the shipped files.
- **Teacher model:** Gemini-2.5-Flash (default `gemini-2.5-flash`; see
  [`../scripts/00_generate/config_mmad.py`](../scripts/00_generate/config_mmad.py)).
- **Source images are NOT shipped** (re-downloadable). Use
  [`../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py`](../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py).
  See §6 for how to resolve the image paths.

## 3. Generation parameters and the "C1-only" convention

Traces were produced by
[`../scripts/00_generate/generate_realiad_traces.py`](../scripts/00_generate/generate_realiad_traces.py)
with the inspector system prompts in [`../prompts/`](../prompts/).

| Parameter | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Teacher | Gemini-2.5-Flash, single pass ("C1-only" = Real-IAD camera view **C1** only) |
| Temperature | 1.0 |
| Batch size | 5–10 images per request (`BATCH_SIZE = 10`, retries `MAX_RETRIES = 3`) |
| Target length | **120–200 words** inside the `<think>` block (`inspector_prompt_test_v2.txt`, "Target 120 to 200 words") |
| Images per **anomaly** | **3** — (1) original, (2) original with the anomaly region highlighted in red (overlay), (3) a normal **reference** image of the same product/view |
| Images per **normal** | **1** — the original image only |
| Output | Strict JSON, response schema enforced via `response_mime_type="application/json"` + a Pydantic model |
| API | Gemini via Vertex (`GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`) or API key (`GEMINI_API_KEYS` in `.env`) |

> **Generation vs. training image count.** During *generation*, anomalies are shown 3
> images (orig + overlay + reference) so the teacher can localize the defect without leaking
> labels. The **shipped training records contain only the single original `C1` image**
> (1 image per record, anomaly and normal alike). The overlay and reference images are
> generation-time scaffolding (overlays are built by `create_overlay()` in
> [`../scripts/00_generate/utils_realiad.py`](../scripts/00_generate/utils_realiad.py)) and
> are not part of the trace dataset.

The output format expected from the teacher (and present in every record):

- **Normal:** `<think>...</think><answer>No</answer>`
- **Anomaly:** `<think>...</think><location>...</location><type>...</type><answer>Yes</answer>`

## 5. Record format

Two on-disk schemas appear in `traces/`:

**(a) LlamaFactory chat-vision schema** (all SFT files): one user turn + one assistant turn,
plus a parallel `images` list. The `<image>` token in the user content maps to the single
entry in `images`.

```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "<image>\nAnalyze the provided image of the transistor1. Determine if there are any anomalies present. If an anomaly is detected, specify its type and location, and provide a detailed reasoning for your conclusion."
    },
    {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "<think>\n...inspection reasoning...\n</think>\n<location>top-right</location>\n<type>Scratch</type>\n<answer>Yes</answer>"
    }
  ],
  "images": [
    "<path-to>/Real-IAD/images/<product>/NG/<defect>/<sample>/<file>_C1_<ts>.jpg"
  ]
}
```

A normal record's assistant content ends with `<think>...</think>\n<answer>No</answer>` and
omits `<location>`/`<type>`.

**(b) GRPO prompt-only schema** (the `*grpo_train.json` files): one record per image with
explicit metadata and a reference completion (used by the GRPO rollout/reward harness, not
as teacher-forced text):

```json
{
  "image_id": "eraser_OK_S0485_eraser_0485_OK_C1_20231005141031",
  "image_path": "<path-to>/Real-IAD/images/eraser/OK/S0485/eraser_0485_OK_C1_20231005141031.jpg",
  "product": "eraser",
  "is_anomaly": false,
  "question": "Analyze the provided image of the eraser. ...",
  "answer": "<think>...</think>\n<answer>No</answer>",
  "gt_label": "..."
}
```

The user prompt comes in two variants across files: the **long template** ("Analyze the
provided image of the {product}. Determine if there are any anomalies present...") and a
**bare** variant ("Are there any defects in the query image?", in
`iad_sft_6k_bareprompt_train.json`). The thesis prompt-mode contract for *evaluation* is
encoded as a filename suffix (`_trainprompt` / `_grpoprompt` / `_bareprompt`); for these
*training* JSONs the prompt is embedded directly in each record.

---

## 6. How images are obtained, and the path situation

The trace JSONs ship **text only**. The source images (Real-IAD, and the Variety subset) are
**re-downloadable** and are **not** included.

> **Path mismatch to be aware of.** [`../README.md`](../README.md) describes the `images`
> entries as **relative paths** designed to line up with the downloaded source collections.
> The **shipped JSONs currently contain absolute paths** rooted at the author's machine, e.g.
> `/bulk/aacudad/reasoning_traces/reasoning_traces_gen/data/Real-IAD/images/...`
> (and `.../data/realiad-variety/...` for the Variety files). To use the data after
> re-downloading the images, rewrite the path prefix up to and including `/data/` to point at
> your local download root. The portion **from `/Real-IAD/images/...` onward** is the stable,
> portable tail and matches the layout produced by
> [`../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py`](../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py).
> A path-rewriting pass to make these relative is recommended before any public release.

Resolution recipe:

1. Run [`../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py`](../scripts/00_generate/download_realiad.py)
   to fetch Real-IAD into a local `data/Real-IAD/images/...` tree.
2. Replace the leading `/bulk/.../reasoning_traces_gen/data/` prefix in each `images` /
   `image_path` entry with your local `data/` root.
3. Register the dataset with LlamaFactory via
   [`../configs/dataset_info.json`](../configs/dataset_info.json) (the `iad_sft_*`,
   `iad_grpo_*`, `variety_star_sft_6k` entries map dataset names to these files) and train with
   `llamafactory-cli train <yaml>` using the configs in [`../configs/sft/`](../configs/sft/)
   and [`../configs/grpo/`](../configs/grpo/).

## 7. Quality control

> **There is no second-reviewer model in the QC of the shipped AnomalyThink-15K corpus.**
> QC for the headline corpus is **in-prompt auto-reject rules + JSON/Pydantic schema
> validation only**. There is **no GPT-5-mini reviewer, no separate 8-rubric filter model**,
> and the corpus was **not** quality-filtered to produce the 6K (the 6K is a clean stratified
> subsample of the 14,472).

**Two QC mechanisms (both within the single generation pass):**

1. **In-prompt auto-reject rules** (from
   [`../prompts/inspector_prompt_test_v2.txt`](../prompts/inspector_prompt_test_v2.txt),
   "AUTO-REJECT RULES"). A trace is rejected immediately on any of:
   - **A. Batch/Sequence leakage** — references another image / previous-next-final item / batch / ordinal position.
   - **B. Metadata leakage** — references labels, annotations, hints, ground truth, or being told the answer.
   - **C. Evidence-order failure** — names the defect before describing the supporting visual evidence.
   - **D. Wrong output structure** — missing `image_id`, missing reasoning, anomalous trace missing `<location>`/`<type>`/`<answer>Yes</answer>`, normal trace with content after `</think>` other than `<answer>No</answer>`, or invalid JSON.
   - **E. Unsupported defect claim** — anomaly asserted without concrete visible evidence.
   - **F. Overstated causality** — an unseen cause stated as definite fact rather than a cautious possibility.

   The prompt also carries a self-scoring rubric (accept only if no auto-reject fires, total
   ≥ 13/16, and Visual Grounding / Evidence-Before-Conclusion / Single-Image-Independence /
   Output-Structure each score 2). This rubric is **part of the generation prompt** (the
   teacher's own instructions) — it is **not** a separate downstream judge model.

2. **Schema validation.** Every batch response must parse as strict JSON
   (`response_mime_type="application/json"`) and validate against the `BatchReasoningTraces` /
   `ReasoningTrace` Pydantic models in
   [`../scripts/00_generate/generate_realiad_traces.py`](../scripts/00_generate/generate_realiad_traces.py).
   Batches that fail are retried (up to `MAX_RETRIES = 3`), with API-key/model rotation on
   rate limits.

**Controlled output vocabularies** (enforced in-prompt, used in the cleaning pass below):

- **Location** — exactly one (or comma-separated several) of a fixed 3×3 grid:
  `top-left, top-center, top-right, middle-left, center, middle-right, bottom-left,
  bottom-center, bottom-right`. Free-form words like "left"/"right"/"top"/"center-left" are
  disallowed.
- **Type** — one of a fixed defect-type list (Surface: Scratch, Crack, Dent, Pit, Abrasion,
  Discoloration, Contamination, Corrosion, Stain, Burr, Flash; Structural: Broken, Fracture,
  Deformation, Warping, Chip, Damage, Bend; Completeness: Missing Parts, Missing Component,
  Extra Component, Incomplete Assembly; Other: Misalignment, Foreign Object, Poor Finish,
  Overmolding).

---

## 8. Documented cleaning deltas

A post-generation cleaning pass normalizes the structured fields without rewriting the
reasoning text:

- **Location vocabulary fix** — any teacher output that drifted from the 3×3 grid (e.g.
  bare "left"/"right"/"top"/"bottom", "center-left", or invented coordinates) is mapped back
  to the nearest allowed grid term.
- **Type vocabulary fix** — defect-type strings are snapped to the fixed type list
  (canonical capitalization/spelling, e.g. "missing parts" → `Missing Parts`).
- **Structure fixes** — stray tokens after `</think>` on normal traces are dropped so that a
  normal record is exactly `<think>...</think><answer>No</answer>`; anomalous records are
  guaranteed to carry `<location>`, `<type>`, and `<answer>Yes</answer>`.

The `c1_only_fixed/` directory name reflects this normalization pass for the
iteration-2/GRPO-format pool (§4.5). The cleaning does **not** change class labels, does
**not** drop traces for "low quality" beyond the in-prompt auto-rejects, and does **not**
alter trace length — confirming again that 6K vs 15K differ in **composition/count**, not
verbosity.

---

## 9. Intended use, limitations, and licensing notes

- **Intended use.** Training and evaluating reasoning-augmented VLMs for explainable
  industrial anomaly detection (binary anomaly decision + localized defect type/location +
  human-readable reasoning).
- **Teacher-imposed limitations.** Traces are Gemini-2.5-Flash outputs at temperature 1.0;
  they can contain plausible-but-wrong localizations or over-confident defect descriptions.
  The in-prompt QC reduces but does not eliminate this. Treat traces as *supervision signal*,
  not as ground-truth labels — the binary `is_anomaly` / `gt_label` come from Real-IAD, the
  reasoning text comes from the teacher.
- **Class balance.** The headline AnomalyThink files are 50/50 balanced by design; the
  iteration-2/ablation/Variety files reflect natural or arm-specific imbalances (see §4
  Anom/Norm columns).
- **Variety STaR (§4.6) is in progress** — a thesis placeholder. Pipeline: roll out Arm-C
  ckpt-376 → Gemini judge → correct/rewrite → SFT on a 6K stratified variety corpus
  (3,000 anomaly / 3,000 normal, 160 products). Numbers are not finalized.
- **Source-image licensing.** Real-IAD (and the Variety subset) are governed by their own
  upstream licenses/terms; this repository ships only derived text traces and pointers to the
  re-downloadable images. Confirm Real-IAD's terms before redistribution.
- **Secrets.** Generation/judge scripts may still contain credentials (HF tokens, Vertex
  service-account key). **Rotate every credential, add a `.gitignore`, and run `gitleaks`
  before any public commit** — see [`../README.md`](../README.md).

---

*All counts, class balances, mean `<think>` lengths, subset/disjointness relationships, the
record schemas, the controlled vocabularies, and the path situation in this card were verified
directly against the shipped JSONs and the generation prompts/scripts in this repository.*
